title: Species delimitation of a phyloseq object with ABGD or ASAP — delim_pq
text: Run single-locus species-delimitation analysis reference sequences phyloseq-class object map resulting partitions back onto taxa. Two barcode-gap methods available delimtools package: ABGD (Automatic Barcode Gap Discovery, Puillandre et al. 2012) ASAP (Assemble Species Automatic Partitioning, Puillandre et al. 2021). external command-line programs: either give path executable exe, pass result file downloaded corresponding web server webserver. default taxa belonging partition merged MiscMetabar::merge_taxa_vec(), delim_pq() acts post-clustering step comparable MiscMetabar::postcluster_pq(), driven barcode gap rather fixed similarity threshold.
